title: Edits to a local Claude Code plugin never show up
symptoms: The plugin behaves like the old version after editing its source
cause: Claude Code runs a frozen copy from ~/.claude/plugins/cache/{marketplace}/{plugin}/{version}/, not the source folder. Without a version bump the cache is never refreshed.
fix: Bump the version in .claude-plugin/plugin.json, update the marketplace and the plugin, then restart or reload plugins.
apply: claude plugin marketplace update <marketplace> && claude plugin update <plugin>@<marketplace>
